tasks.description: Create a deterministic release manifest from prior artifacts.
command: from hashlib import sha256; from pathlib import Path; source=Path('src/greeting.py').read_bytes(); report=Path('reports/contract.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip(); out=Path('dist/manifest.txt'); out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); out.write_text(f'source_sha256={sha256(source).hexdigest()}\ncontract={report}\n',encoding='utf-8')
